t: What Historical Population Database Is All About
title: What Historical Population Database Is All About
description: Historical population reconstructs the counted: parish registers (the baptized: Wrigley), censuses (the 1790+: US), estimates (McEvedy/Jones: the world), and the transitions (the demographic: births-deaths).
